text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Symboli Rudolf completely immerses herself in her training, Narita Brian arrives to inform her about a problem on the student council.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The general manager, not wanting to be a burden to the president she respects, has asked to resign.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After some thought, Symboli Rudolf asks the general manager to come and watch her run in the Satsuki Sho.
